info.title: mattergram managed native forms
info.description: Authored SDK ingress contract; server/client version evidence is separate in manifests/forms-profile.json.

post.x-authentication: Controlled authenticated server transport and explicit peer CIDRs, then opaque state/context capability bound to the stored native actor/scope/opening-callback/revision. The revision-zero form capability can perform current-schema lookup or cancellation after transitions; stale submission/refresh/action writes remain rejected. Forwarded headers are not actor evidence.

200.description: One explicit native response: ACK, validation error(s), managed next/refresh form, or lookup items. Terminal replay returns the stored result.

400.description: Malformed, ambiguous or invalid event family/lookup values

403.description: Rejected peer, capability, scope, callback ID, operation or expiry

409.description: Stale step, inactive parent/live child, modal-depth limit, or uncertain outcome requiring application reconciliation

500.description: Handler failed or form response was not explicitly completed

504.description: Initial request deadline expired; no automatic successful ACK
